name: placa (Tube) Shell intercambiador de calor
full_description: el pagina oficial explains que el plate es el core heat-transfer component de el plate-shell intercambiador de calor. THT lists plate structures incluidos chocolate-shaped ripple, horizontal ripple, oblique ripple, y herringbone ripple forms. Plates son formed through one-piece pressing y then edge-cut por laser para consistent dimensions. After each single plate tube y plate bundle es soldado, un air-tightness test de 0.6-0.7MPa es performed. el page indica que part de el shell-type equipos can withstand 6.0MPa operating pressure y has been used en nuclear power, military, y other major equipos projects.
advantage: Multiple placa corrugation structures para different condiciones de operacion.
One-piece placa pressing y laser edge cutting improve dimensional consistency.
Each soldado placa tube y paquete de placas receives air-tightness testing.
Part del shell equipos puede withstand 6.0MPa operating presion.
